steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Sustainable mobility  
   • Expand and modernize public transit (BRT, light rail)  
   • Build safe infrastructure for walking and cycling  
   • Incentivize electric vehicles (charging networks, low-emission zones)  

2. Green buildings and energy efficiency  
   • Enforce strict building codes (insulation, efficient HVAC, LED lighting)  
   • Retrofit existing homes and offices with smart controls and heat pumps  
   • Deploy on-site renewables (solar panels, geothermal)  

3. Smart urban planning and clean energy  
   • Promote compact, mixed-use development to cut commute distances  
   • Increase urban green spaces and tree canopy (carbon sequestration, cooling)  
   • Power municipal services with renewables and microgrids (rooftop solar, wind)
